title: fix: duplicate sidebar, game UX loading states, leave persistence, hangman init, SW cache, opportunity buttons
body:
# Pull Request Template

## Description
Fixes multiple UI bugs reported on the live site:

1. **Duplicate sidebar** on `/admin/opportunity-analytics` and `/admin/game-manager` — these pages rendered their own `<AdminSidebar />` and `<ProtectedRoute>` wrapper on top of the admin layout which already provides both
2. **Game button loading states** — Create Game, Play Now, Join, and Leave buttons now show loading feedback when pressed
3. **Leave session persistence** — Leaving a game room now properly deletes the Firestore doc (if solo) or sets status to `ended` (if opponent present). Room list filters out ended/result rooms
4. **Hangman "lost" before start** — `[].every()` returns true on empty word, triggering game over before word loads. Added guard `word.length > 0`
5. **Firestore rules for games** — Update/delete rules used broken `hostId`/`in` operator check. Fixed to check `players.player1.uid`/`players.player2.uid`
6. **Service worker Cache.put error** — Wrapped cache writes in try-catch, skip opaque responses
7. **Opportunity card buttons overlap** — Changed to flex-col + flex-wrap layout so buttons stack on narrow cards

## Type of Change
- [x] Bug fix

## Pre-Submission Checklist

### Code Quality
- [x] Code follows existing style and conventions
- [x] No console.log() statements left in
- [x] No hardcoded secrets or sensitive data
- [x] No unnecessary dependencies added

### Security Review
- [x] Firestore rules updated to properly check player UIDs
- [x] No extra fields accepted in request bodies
- [x] Errors don't leak sensitive information

### Testing
- [x] Lint passes clean (only pre-existing warnings)
- [x] Edge cases considered (empty word, solo player leave, opaque responses)

## Modified Files
- `firestore.rules` — Fixed games collection update/delete rules
- `public/sw.js` — Cache.put error handling
- `src/app/admin/game-manager/page.js` — Removed duplicate sidebar/wrapper
- `src/app/admin/opportunity-analytics/page.js` — Removed duplicate sidebar/wrapper
- `src/components/GameCard.jsx` — Loading states for create/join
- `src/components/UserRoomsList.jsx` — Loading states for join/leave, proper leave logic, filter ended rooms
- `src/components/games/HangmanGame.jsx` — Guard win/loss against empty word
- `src/components/OpportunityCard.jsx` — Flex-wrap buttons to prevent overflow

## Security Considerations
- [x] Firestore rules now properly validate player UIDs for update/delete
- [x] Both players can delete game docs they participate in

## Post-Merge
- [ ] Deploy Firestore rules: `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules`

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/61be72cb66424e9b871292e63cddc783
Requested by: @okcharliesa-creator
